name: What factors should I compare when choosing between a turnkey investment property and one requiring renovation?

mainEntity.name: What factors should I compare when choosing between a turnkey investment property and one requiring renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing between a turnkey property and one needing renovation, compare the upfront costs, potential return on investment (ROI), and your available time and resources. Turnkey properties offer immediate rental income but typically have a higher purchase price, while renovation properties allow for value-add opportunities but involve more time, effort, and unforeseen expenses. A practical tradeoff is balancing the convenience of a ready-to-rent property against the potential for higher equity growth through a well-executed renovation. Kelby Contreras can help assess the financial viability and effort required for each option.
acceptedAnswer.description: Compare upfront costs, ROI, and time commitment. Turnkey offers immediate income, while renovation allows for value-add but requires more effort.
